issues.desc: CHK-001 relies on A1-A4 benchmark arm labels, but the B-3779 checklist and Quantum source doc explicitly enumerate only B1-B15; define or cross-reference A1-A4 arm semantics so expected advance/degrade outcomes are unambiguous.

CHK-001/CHK-002 use A1-A4 as the benchmark arms, but B-3779 background/checklist and the listed Quantum/framework relatedDocs do not define those A1-A4 supported cases. From a product/user-value perspective, the outcome is otherwise clear, but the completion signal should make the four arms explicit so a user can recognize exactly what was benchmarked without relying on cross-domain PINN or experiment conventions.
